## Definition of done

- [ ] No client names, project names, people, tenant screenshots or internal system names
- [ ] Licence and admin requirements stated (Copilot Chat vs Microsoft 365 Copilot, preview, admin opt-in, usage billing)
- [ ] "Where it falls short" filled in honestly
- [ ] Linked from the README index
- [ ] For documents: `template.docx` regenerated with `scripts/build-docx.sh`
